tip: AC ka temperature 24-26°C rakhein, har 1°C kam karne se 6-8% zyada bijli khti hai.
AC ke saath ceiling fan chalayein, isse aap temperature 2-3 degree zyada rakh sakte hain aur comfort same rahega.
5-star rated inverter AC, 3-star fixed-speed AC se 20-30% kam bijli kharch karta hai.
AC filter har 2-3 hafte mein clean karein, dirty filter se compressor zyada mehnat karta hai aur bijli zyada lagti hai.
AC chalane se pehle room ke curtains/blinds band kar dein dopahar mein, direct sunlight se room garam hota hai.
Sleep mode use karein raat ko, ye automatically temperature thoda badha deta hai jab aap so jaate hain.
AC ko bar-bar on-off na karein, isse compressor pe extra load padta hai jo zyada bijli kharch karta hai.
Fridge ko deewar se kam se kam 4-6 inch door rakhein taaki heat properly dissipate ho sake.
Fridge ka door bar-bar na kholein aur zyada der tak khula na rakhein, andar ka temperature maintain karne mein extra bijli lagti hai.
Garam khana fridge mein rakhne se pehle room temperature tak thanda hone dein.
Fridge ki temperature setting 4°C (fridge) aur -18°C (freezer) se zyada low na rakhein, zaroorat se zyada thanda karna bijli waste karta hai.
Full load mein hi washing machine chalayein, half load mein bhi utni hi bijli lagti hai.
Cold water wash cycle use karein jab possible ho, pani garam karna sabse zyada bijli kharch karta hai washing machine mein.
Geyser ko zaroorat se 15-20 min pehle hi on karein, continuously on rakhne se bahut bijli waste hoti hai.
Geyser ka temperature 50-55°C rakhein, isse zyada garam karna extra bijli lagti hai bina extra benefit ke.
Instant geyser (chhoti capacity) storage geyser se kam bijli kharch karta hai agar usage kam hai to.
LED bulbs use karein, CFL se 50% aur incandescent se 80% kam bijli kharch karte hain same brightness ke liye.
Din mein natural light use karein, khidkiyan khuli rakhein jab tak possible ho.
Jis room mein koi na ho wahan ki lights band kar dein, chhoti aadat bade savings deti hai.
TV, set-top box, charger jaise devices standby mode mein bhi bijli kharch karte hain, poora switch off karein.
Smart power strip use karein jisse ek click mein saare standby devices band ho jayein.
5-star BEE rated appliances kharidein, shuru mein thoda mehenge hote hain par 2-3 saal mein bijli bill se recover ho jaata hai.
Appliances ki regular servicing karayein, purane/dirty appliances zyada bijli kharch karte hain.
Solar water heater install karne se geyser ka 60-70% load khatam ho sakta hai, especially North India mein.
Induction cooktop gas se bijli mein zyada efficient hota hai agar flat-bottom bartan use karein.
Microwave, oven se kam bijli aur kam time leta hai chhoti quantity garam karne mein.
Mixer grinder continuously 2-3 min se zyada na chalayein, motor garam hoke zyada current khenchta hai.
Electricity bill slab-based hota hai — agar aap next slab ke close hain, thoda sa usage kam karke aap poore bill mein bade % savings pa sakte hain.
Peak hours (sham 6-10 baje) mein heavy appliances (washing machine, iron) avoid karein, kuch states mein time-of-day pricing hoti hai.
Monthly meter reading note karte rahein taaki aapko pata chale kis mahine consumption achanak badha.
Garmi mein cooler, AC se 70-80% kam bijli kharch karta hai agar humidity kam ho to.
Terrace/roof pe halka paint ya white sheet se ghar thanda rehta hai, AC ka load kam hota hai.
Exhaust fan subah-shaam use karein garam hawa bahar nikalne ke liye, AC kam chalana padega.
Geyser ka usage winter mein sabse zyada badhta hai, time-based usage (sirf nahane se pehle) savings deta hai.
Room heater ki jagah agar possible ho to layered clothing use karein, heater bahut zyada bijli kharch karta hai (1500-2500W).
Diwali/festival lights LED string lights use karein, traditional bulbs se 80% kam bijli kharch karte hain.
Festival decoration lights ke liye timer laga dein, raat 11-12 baje ke baad automatically band ho jayein.
Water pump ko overhead tank full hote hi band karein, automatic water level sensor laga sakte hain.
Pump ki pipeline mein leakage check karein, leakage se pump zyada der chalana padta hai.
Rooftop solar panel lagwane se grid se bijli consumption 40-90% tak kam ho sakta hai, government subsidy bhi milti hai.
Net metering connection lein agar solar panel lagate hain, extra bijli grid ko bech sakte hain.
Family mein sabko bijli bill dikhayein aur ek simple goal set karein (jaise '10% kam karna is mahine'), awareness se bhi savings hoti hai.
Appliance use karne ka ek schedule banayein especially high-wattage appliances ke liye taaki overlap na ho.
Bijli bill ko sirf paisa nahi, carbon footprint ke roop mein bhi dekhein — kam usage environment ke liye bhi acha hai.
Geyser, AC, aur iron ek saath kabhi na chalayein agar connection load limited hai, isse MCB trip bhi ho sakta hai aur peak load bhi badhta hai.
Iron karte waqt saare kapde ek saath rakhein, baar-baar heat-up karna (on-off) zyada bijli kharch karta hai.
Induction cooktop ka use bade bartan ke liye karein, chhote bartan se heat zyada waste hoti hai.
Smart plug ya energy monitor use karke pata karein kaunsa appliance sabse zyada bijli kharch kar raha hai.
Monthly usage pattern track karein — achanak spike dikhe to kisi appliance mein fault ho sakta hai.
BEE star rating label har appliance pe check karein kharidte waqt, zyada stars = kam running cost.
